question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Pitiable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pitiable"** means deserving or arousing pity; something that is sorrowful or pathetic. (दया योग्य)

 
 
• **Example:** The abandoned puppy looked so **pitiable **that we couldn't help but take it home.
 
 
 
• **"Pleasant"** refers to something that is enjoyable, pleasing, or giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment. (सुखद)
 
 
• **Example:** The weather today is so **pleasant **that it makes me want to go for a long walk in the park.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'pitiable'** is **'pleasant'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Eradicate** (उन्मूलन करना): To completely destroy or put an end to something.

 
 
• **Example:** Efforts are being made to eradicate polio from the world.
 
 
 
• **Grievous** (गंभीर): Causing great sorrow or pain; very severe or serious.
 
 
• **Example:** The accident was a grievous event that affected the entire community.
 
 
 
• **Aggregate** (समुच्चय): Formed by the collection of units or particles into a body, mass, or amount.
 
 
• **Example:** The aggregate score of the team was higher than that of their competitors.
